results.title: extension UI: RPC dialogs, timeouts, no persistence across restart
results.summary: Dialogs cross the RPC boundary as extension_ui_request/response with client ids, with three measured deviations: options nest under one field (not the documented flat shape), the documented dialog timeout does NOT fire in RPC mode (measured: 4s past a 1500ms timeout, still pending), and pending dialogs die with the process — verified by killing mid-dialog and restarting on the same dirs: extension reloads, zero dialog requests replay. The AegisPi host must therefore own dialog deadlines AND durable parking (04 §2), reading the nested wire shape.

findings.name: dialog-wire-shape-deviation
findings.detail: docs/rpc-extension-ui.md documents flat fields (title/message/timeout/options/prefill at top level); the live 1.5.2 wire nests the entire options object under the first field name. Host adapter must read the nested shape and must not rely on doc examples

findings.name: dialog-timeout-not-dependable
findings.detail: confirm(timeout:1500) still pending after 4s and no completion notify; documented auto-resolve did NOT fire. Host must own dialog deadlines

findings.name: restart-loads-extension
findings.detail: restart process lists probe_ui command — the extension reloads on the same agent dir

findings.name: no-dialog-replay-after-restart
findings.detail: after SIGKILL with a confirm pending, a fresh process on the same dirs emitted 0 unprompted extension_ui_request(s) and 0 reused dialog id(s) — pending dialogs die with the process in 1.5.2, so the host must implement durable parking itself (save state → park → restart → re-ask)

results.title: usage parsing, catalog-based cost, missing-usage zeros
results.summary: Usage parses from the final streamed chunk (input/output/totalTokens), cost derives from catalog prices (deepseek-flash 0.3/1.2), cost.totalFromProvider is a boolean false on the usage-present path, and the provider-omission path yields all-zero numbers with NO totalFromProvider key on cost — an untrustworthy shape for settlement, recorded as such. The host-side HELD ledger is Phase 2 work, explicitly not claimed as done here.

findings.name: cost-totalFromProvider-is-boolean-false
findings.detail: cost.totalFromProvider = false (typeof boolean); declared totalFromProvider?: boolean in pi-ai dist/types.d.ts; ledger sums input+output+cache itself per 06 §8

findings.name: sdk-message_update-no-usage
findings.detail: SDK message_update events (3) do not carry usage; usage is authoritative on message_end.message.usage (JSON/RPC mode adds usage to message_update records per docs/json.md)

findings.name: missing-usage-shape-zeros-no-provider-total
findings.detail: usage with provider omission: {"input":0,"output":0,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0,"totalTokens":0,"cost":{"input":0,"output":0,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0,"total":0}} — all nine numeric fields (usage input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite/totalTokens, cost input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite/total) are pinned === 0 AND cost has no totalFromProvider key (absent, not false, not a number). Nothing here proves a zero-cost outcome; the host ledger (Phase 2, not yet implemented) must hold such responses un-settled (HELD) until a trustworthy usage or bill arrives (06 §8)

findings.name: ledger-sums-itself
findings.detail: usage carries per-field numbers only (input/output/cache*, cost.total) with cost.totalFromProvider as a boolean flag on the usage-present path and ABSENT on the omission path — never a provider-reported total; the Phase 2 ledger must sum input+output+cache itself and treat missing usage as un-settled (HELD). The host-side HELD gate is not implemented in Phase 1 and is not claimed as done.

results.title: cacheWarming default, decision event, eligibility
results.summary: Pi 1.5.2 defaults cacheWarming to 'idle' — measured conflict with the AegisPi 'off by default' rule. The shipped defaults.json's budget.cacheWarming='off' reaches Pi's runtime settings ONLY through the single loader module (raw file -> SettingsManager reads 'idle', asserted as a hazard; loader-mapped settings -> 'off', asserted). The Phase 2 daemon must load the file through that module — recorded, not claimed as runtime enforcement. cache_warming_decision is a declared override event; deepseek-flash is warming-ineligible; future warming must be budgeted as purpose=warming.

results.title: RPC LF byte framing: U+2028/29, chunked UTF-8, overlong, stderr
results.summary: LF byte framing holds on both directions, now measured with a cut inside the 3 UTF-8 bytes of a CJK char (input buffers mid-character until LF), CRLF stripped, U+2028/U+2029 intact in single frames both ways, and 1.5MiB single lines accepted. On locked Node 22.23.5 readline matches byte-LF frames exactly (asserted); the v24 split hazard is recorded via the standalone repro tool. Host-side max-frame/buffer/idle caps remain a normative adapter duty.
